title: List the IDs and ages of female patients aged 50 or older who were not admi
question: List the IDs and ages of female patients aged 50 or older who were not admitted to the hospital, have abnormal red blood cell counts, and also show either elevated blood glucose (≥180) with normal total cholesterol (<250) or abnormal fibrinogen levels (≤150 or ≥450).

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
    P."XCL_058",
    STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060") AS age
FROM Patient AS P
INNER JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', P."XCL_060")) >= 50
  AND E."XCL_013" = 0
  AND (L."XCL_019" < 3.5 OR L."XCL_019" > 5.0)
  AND (
    (L."XCL_029" >= 180 AND L."XCL_026" < 250)
    OR L."XCL_036" <= 150
    OR L."XCL_036" >= 450
  )
